description:
Upstream's StdinBuffer recognizes DCS (`ESC P ... ESC \`) and APC (`ESC _ ... ESC \`) sequence types and buffers them until the ST terminator arrives. Our StdinFSM only handles CSI (`ESC [`), OSC (`ESC ]`), and SS3 (`ESC O`). DCS and APC sequences will be mis-parsed — the `ESC P` or `ESC _` prefix will be emitted as an alt-prefix event, and the body/terminator will be emitted as garbage.

This matters because Kitty graphics responses arrive as APC sequences, and XTVersion responses arrive as DCS.

Implement `extract_dcs` and `extract_apc` in StdinFSM.extract/1, mirroring the existing extract_osc pattern (buffer until `ESC \` ST terminator).

Ref: `stdin-buffer.ts` L55-60, L146-178.
title: StdinFSM: handle DCS and APC escape sequences
